translation: One should take Jiawei Jianbu Huqian Wan (Modified Agile-Steps Tiger-Crouching Pill, 加味健步虎潛丸), fumigate and wash with Haitongpi Tang (Erythrina Bark Decoction, 海桐皮湯), and moxa-iron and iron on Dingtong San (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散). <ins>Jiawei Jianbu Huqian Wan</ins> (Modified Agile-Steps Tiger-Crouching Pill, 加味健步虎潛丸) specifically treats injuries from falls and blows with deficiency and decline of qi and blood, and pain of the lower body, the lumbar, hip, knee, and leg, with soreness, weakness, and lack of strength, and difficulty in walking. Taking this medicine up to one hundred days relaxes the sinews and stops pain, quickens the blood and tonifies qi, and invigorates the spirit.
